direct_dependency_rationale.gpui: Keep the external crate named gpui because every existing app module already uses gpui and upstream entities must have exactly the same source identity.
direct_dependency_rationale.gpui_platform: Native application bootstrap plus macOS font-kit and runtime_shaders. Upstream gpui itself does not expose runtime_shaders at this pin.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_editor: Actual editor package, aliased to avoid confusion with local editing modules.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_language: Local Buffer constructor and language types.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_multi_buffer: Use directly only if the adapter constructs or inspects MultiBuffer; removable for an adapter exclusively calling Editor::for_buffer.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_settings: Default settings store and keymap parser.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_theme: Theme registry and theme types; removable as direct dependency if the adapter only uses theme_settings reexports.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_release_channel: Global app/release metadata initialization; exact required globals owned by adapter agent.
direct_dependency_rationale.zed_util: Required debug-build embedding feature unification; no runtime calls needed.

manifest_qualification: This is a precise source-supported dependency/patch shape, not a Cargo-tested manifest. Remove unused direct types after adapter compilation. No optional editor feature removes Project/Workspace from its dependency graph.

mandatory_macos_workspace_closure.method: Recursively read pinned workspace manifests into memory; merge workspace dependency features, activated/default features and optional feature dependencies; include normal/build dependencies under aarch64 macOS/Unix cfg; exclude dev-dependencies and test-support. Roots editor, gpui, gpui_platform(font-kit,runtime_shaders). Adding util/debug-embed does not add workspace crates. This is a source-level internal closure, not a complete resolved Cargo package graph.
nonoptional_native_external: wasmtime-c-api-impl 48.0.0 with cranelift,gc,gc-null via language tree-sitter[wasm]
mandatory_macos_workspace_closure.cross_platform_resolution_caution: Cargo lock generation resolves additional target-dependent packages. metadata --filter-platform filters output but is not proof those source fetches are avoided. The 99 count concerns the selected macOS compilation source graph.

patch_evidence.root_patch_inheritance: An external Git dependency workspace root patch table is not inherited by the consuming AgentWatcher root. Carry selected patch entries in AgentWatcher root.

tree-sitter-language.reason: Source/type identity: pinned tree-sitter uses its workspace LanguageFn; registry tree-sitter-json produces registry tree-sitter-language LanguageFn unless root patch unifies source. tree_sitter::Language::new takes LanguageFn and From<LanguageFn> impl is tied to source identity.

async-task.reason: Upstream exact fork fixes task waker vtable identity and redundant readiness wakeups; mandatory consumers gpui,scheduler,gpui_apple. Preserve behavior even where registry may compile.

async-process.reason: smol transitive dependency; upstream fork adds adopting child process by PID on macOS. Preserve pinned upstream behavior; all call sites requiring fork not exhaustively proved.

notify.reason: Mandatory fs dependency requires version 9.0.0-rc.4; exact fork adds FsEventStreamStart error reporting. Preserve selected macOS filesystem semantics.

notify-types.reason: Companion patched dependency from the same notify revision; upstream lock has version 2.1.0.

patch_evidence.excluded_patches: cpal/livekit/libwebrtc/webrtc-sys absent selected graph; calloop/khronos-egl Linux-specific; windows-capture Windows-specific. Adding unrelated patch entries may force extra source fetches; do not blindly copy entire upstream patch table.

scratch.reason: Local tooling/corgi/patches/scratch is explicitly a Corgi-compatible replacement to avoid embedded OUT_DIR sharing. Normal Cargo integration does not inherit the upstream patch and does not need to copy that local path. If scratch is reached through a CXX external build dependency, registry scratch is the normal Cargo implementation; selected macOS source closure has no direct scratch/CXX dependency. External transitive closure not exhaustively resolved.

debug_asset_fix.dependency: zed_util = { package = "util", git = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed", rev = "aa9c16803dd841950e3d4f4c7ecd76f324e0ba44", default-features = false, features = ["debug-embed"] }
debug_asset_fix.reason: Without debug-embed, util::fs_embed! debug mode finds the running app repo through .git and reads root-relative assets there. settings::init calls settings/default.json through SettingsAssets and panics if absent. debug-embed unifies the feature across upstream util and embeds each crate-relative pinned asset at compile time. Release already embeds. No source patch/fork needed.

assets_and_build.upstream_layout: Preserve pinned full repository layout. Cargo Git checkout preserves sibling paths automatically; a hand-extracted editor subtree is insufficient.

shader_source_reads.behavior: cbindgen reads ../gpui source at build-script runtime. runtime_shaders stitches source instead of calling xcrun metal/metallib. Metal shader compilation still occurs at application runtime.

assets_and_build.proto: proto/build.rs uses protox and prost-build on proto/zed.proto; no external protoc invocation in this script.
assets_and_build.xcode_sdk: ui/build.rs still invokes xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-version; runtime_shaders does not remove the Xcode/SDK prerequisite.
assets_and_build.optional_general_assets_crate: editor assets dependency is optional/test-support only. Adding upstream assets directly is convenient for complete icon/theme/font assets but not mandatory for Editor types; its AssetSource bundles fonts/icons/images/themes/sounds/prompts/*.md. AgentWatcher may supply its own AssetSource containing needed editor UI icons, themes and existing fonts.
assets_and_build.fonts: Upstream contains IBM Plex Sans and Lilex; AgentWatcher retains required IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono with upstream font licenses. Adding assets crate does not supply JetBrains Mono.

submodules.evidence: GitHub recursive tree API for immutable revision returned truncated=false, no mode=160000 entries; .gitmodules raw path 404.
